name: Joshua Leeds
reason: Health rule, and his work is psychoacoustics rather than spiritual teaching: his own site (joshualeeds.com home, works, educator and Sound Breath Toolkit pages, read 4 Nov 2026) presents him as a music producer and educator for healthcare, education and therapy professionals, and his current flagship, the Sound Breath Toolkit and the book Sound & Breath for Autonomic Balance, is sold as anxiety and stress relief and a remedy for nervous system dysregulation; The Power of Sound is subtitled How to Be Healthy and Productive Using Music and Sound, and the rest is calming music for pets. Almost nothing would pass the health-claim rule. (His home page does name The Shift Network as a previous course venue.)
